provenance.codex_side: distilled SPECTER2 student, calibrated top-K decision policy 8ed616afcb56, support-gated per head
provenance.gemma_side: direct full-frame Gemma labels, title-only instrument (no abstract); not interchangeable with the abstract-fed round-100 teacher pass

limitations: predictions are machine outputs and not human validated labels
the Gemma side is a direct model label read from the title only; it overcalls metaresearch and undercalls abstract-dependent heads relative to the abstract-fed pass
the Codex side is a distilled student calibrated to design-weighted sample rates; heads without adequate sample support carry no Codex decision, so their consensus is empty
counts are not frame-calibrated prevalence; prevalence claims come from the design-weighted human sample with intervals
direct Codex labels exist only for the 10,348-work training sample
